$comment: Project policy for the hooks in this directory, in the Hatchery base's format (its ADR 0006; the loader is policy.js). Today usage-gate.js and ../statusline.js read it; git-guard.js and post-edit.js still hold this project's rules as constants (ADR 0021) and will read the git and edit blocks when they are next updated from the base. Usage: hold 75 on both meters; deny 100, so the owner's override file lifts either meter or both; DYSTOPO_GATE_OVERRIDE=1 in a session's environment lifts HOLD for that session. Check with: node .claude/hooks/policy.js

usage.holdAdvice: No new implementers (CLAUDE.md, Wave size). Finish work already in flight; a verifier for an already-launched task needs the owner's override. Otherwise wait for the reset or the owner's word.
